summary: Four agents carry an issue from needs-preparation to a squash merge in two phases. The launcher checks every start, then each agent checks its own gate before it hands off. Work returns to the implementer through needs-changes and stops for a maintainer through needs-human.

phases.name: Issue phase
phases.summary: The issue-preparer turns a new issue into criteria an implementer can build against, or asks a maintainer.

phases.name: Implementation and PR phase
phases.summary: One pull request passes from the implementer to the reviewer and the integrator, and back through needs-changes until it merges.

roles.does: Rewrites the issue as final behavior and observable acceptance criteria; links prerequisites as blockers.
Builds or revises one draft PR, runs every check, marks it ready.
Reviews the exact head commit against the issue's criteria, on another CLI and model.
Merges the base in if behind, reruns the final checks, squash-merges or hands to a maintainer.

gates.name: Launcher
gates.passes: The trigger label is on the item, no stop label, no open blocked-by issue, fewer than 5 failed attempts in a row, and with approvals on a maintainer started it.
gates.holds: Parks the item for outside input or an open blocker, marks it failed after 5 attempts; a stop label pauses it.

gates.name: Preparation
gates.passes: The final behavior and the smallest set of observable acceptance criteria are stated; prerequisites are linked as blockers.
gates.holds: needs-human for an unexpected instruction or a scope change it cannot attribute to the request, or a prerequisite that is only a PR.

gates.name: Handoff
gates.passes: Every project check passes without changing its environment, the head merges cleanly with the base, the PR is marked ready.
gates.holds: The PR stays draft and the run reports blocked for a scope decision or a failure the repository cannot fix.

gates.name: Review
gates.passes: The head is still the candidate SHA, the PR is not a draft, the reviewer runs on another CLI and model, and the acceptance criteria pass.
gates.holds: changes-requested sends the PR back through needs-changes; a moved head or a draft reports blocked.

gates.name: Merge
gates.passes: A green Test run applies to the exact head, every owed review applies to it, and the policy lets agents merge it.
gates.holds: maintainer-merge for agent config or guidance, setup, CI or release tooling, outside-input or CLI changes; changes-requested on a conflict or fixable failure.

gates.name: Maintainer
gates.passes: A member of @uberblick-ai/maintainers answers or merges, removes needs-human and re-adds the trigger of the role that acts next.
gates.holds: Nothing moves while needs-human is on the item; a blocked run waits for ub-agents retry.

settings.name: max-attempts
settings.meaning: Failed runs in a row before the item is marked failed.

settings.name: retry-backoff-seconds
settings.meaning: Wait before a retry, doubling up to max-backoff-seconds.

settings.name: agent-timeout-minutes
settings.meaning: Per run; the preparer and integrator get 60, the reviewer 120.

settings.name: queue
settings.meaning: Earlier milestones first, then priority:urgent to priority:low (default medium).

settings.name: approvals
settings.meaning: On while the repository is public: only a maintainer's trigger label starts work.

settings.name: different-runtime-from
settings.meaning: The reviewer never runs on the implementer's CLI and model.

notes: The implementer has no needs-human outcome: it stops by reporting blocked, which leaves an Action needed comment until a maintainer runs ub-agents retry.
